# CharacterCreation

**Tags:** `creation`

What a player chooses when creating a character: a name (rules and uniqueness), a gender (a fixed chibi body preset), a hair style of that gender and a hair colour. Attributes are not chosen; every character starts at base. Cute, chunky chibi figures: a big head, short limbs, bold hair. Our own designs.

> **Goal:** Let a player become a recognisable character in one short screen, generated from data, without a pay or class gate

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `nameRules` | json | yes | Name length, scripts, separators, uniqueness folding and reserved names |
| `genders` | json | yes | The gender options, in display order |
| `presets` | json | yes | Gender -> the appearance entity (body, head, eyes, skin, chibi proportions) |
| `hair` | json | yes | Gender -> hair style ids (each has a UI icon and a mesh at the same key) |
| `hairColors` | json | yes | The curated hair colour list (palette indices in the hair region) |
| `defaultCreation` | json | yes | The creation a skipped screen uses |
| `startingKit` | json | yes | The starting outfit and items per server rule: a plain novice outfit, no class kits |
| `chibiHeadRatio` | json | yes | Allowed head height / total height of a chibi rig |
